name: supertrend_momentum_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: SuperTrend indicator with period=10 and multiplier=3.0 on 1-min bars provides ATR-based trend direction with a dynamic support/resistance level. SuperTrend is particularly popular among Indian traders on Zerodha (it is a default indicator on Kite), creating a self-fulfilling prophecy where many traders enter/exit at SuperTrend flips. The edge exploits this Schelling point: when SuperTrend flips bullish, many retail traders enter simultaneously, creating a brief momentum burst. By entering at the flip with volume confirmation and exiting before the crowd (using a fixed target rather than waiting for re-flip), we capture the initial momentum burst. The edge persists because we are faster than manual retail traders reacting to the same signal.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > 30 crore INR AND listed on Zerodha Kite (maximizes self-fulfilling effect)

long.confirmation: flip bar closes above SuperTrend value AND above previous bar's high

short.confirmation: flip bar closes below SuperTrend value AND below previous bar's low

entry.entry_price: market order on flip confirmation bar close

exit.target: 0.35% from entry (quick scalp on momentum burst, exit before crowd)
exit.stop_loss: SuperTrend value (if price falls back through ST, thesis is broken) OR 0.2%
exit.signal_exit: exit if SuperTrend re-flips within 10 bars (false signal)

filters.volume_filter: volume_ratio > 1.5 on flip bar (confirms institutional participation)
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment (long above VWAP, short below)
other_filters: skip if SuperTrend has flipped >3 times in last 20 bars (whipsaw regime)

edge.edge_decay_risk: high — SuperTrend is extremely popular in India; the self-fulfilling edge is also its crowding risk

weaknesses: SuperTrend is the most popular indicator among Indian retail traders — extreme crowding means the signal edge has likely decayed
The self-fulfilling prophecy works both ways: if too many traders use it, the initial move is pre-empted by algos front-running retail
On 1-min bars, SuperTrend(10,3) has very short lookback — flips are frequent and often false, especially in range-bound markets
prior_art: SuperTrend was developed by Olivier Seban and is widely popular in Indian trading circles. It is essentially a simplified Parabolic SAR with ATR-based levels. Zerodha's Kite platform has it as a default indicator, boosting adoption. Multiple YouTube channels in India teach SuperTrend-based strategies (Vivek Bajaj, P R Sundar).
notes: Edge math: 0.50 * 35bps - 0.50 * 25bps = 17.5 - 12.5 = 5.0 bps gross. Costs ~11 bps. Net ≈ -6.0 bps. Negative. SuperTrend as a standalone signal is likely unprofitable in 2024-2026 due to overcrowding. Its value is as a component in a multi-signal system or as a directional filter. Included because of its extreme popularity in India — important to evaluate and potentially dismiss.
